pages.text: The world is crowded with places to explore: redesigned dungeons and temples, sprawling underground crawls, roadside taverns, and the lairs of the $(l:bosses/mowzie)Mowzie's bosses$(/l).$(br2)An $(l:villages/structures#explorerscompass)Explorer's Compass$(/l) finds whatever you're looking for.
Pick a structure and it points the way.
